settings.title: Bo Rattan Staff Wood
settings.text: A lightweight 4ft-6ft Rattan staff built for flexibility and speed. Features a non-skinned, making it ideal for kata, flow drills, and traditional martial arts practice.

settings.title: Short (Jo) Staff Wood
settings.text: A 4ft martial arts staff crafted from durable Red Oak or Rattan. Compact, balanced, and perfect for close-range practice, kata, and forms training in traditional weapon disciplines.

settings.title: Long (Bo or Gun) Staff Wood
settings.text: Traditional 5ft–6ft martial arts staff crafted from Red Oak or Rattan, available in straight, tapered, or competition styles. Built for strength, speed, and control in training or demonstrations.

settings.text: Train with authentic Arnis and Escrima sticks built for balance, speed, and durability — crafted to enhance coordination and striking accuracy.

settings.title: Escrima Foam Sticks
settings.text: Train safely in Filipino martial arts with foam Escrima sticks that replicate the feel of traditional rattan. Ideal for drills, sparring, and classes, with standard and deluxe padded options.

settings.title: Arnis Stick
settings.text: Handmade in the Philippines from durable rattan wood, these Arnis sticks offer authentic FMA practice with smooth or burnt designs. Perfect for solo drills, partner training, and demonstrations.

settings.title: Rattan Sticks
settings.text: Authentic Filipino martial arts sticks crafted from high-quality rattan for speed, flexibility, and control. Each piece features unique burn designs for both training and display purposes.

From foam to real wood, our selection of training and display swords lets you practice safely and strike with confidence — ideal for Kendo, Kenjutsu, and other sword disciplines.

Important Safety Notice: For training purposes only — not for sparring or contact. Use under supervision, follow safety guidelines, and handle responsibly.

settings.title: Excalibur Long Sword
settings.text: Channel the legend of Excalibur with this 41.7″ polypropylene long sword. Expertly crafted to mirror the elegance and balance of a medieval blade, it’s ideal for solo drills, stage work, or display.

settings.title: Gorkha Sword Kukri PP Machete
settings.text: Inspired by Nepal’s traditional Kukri, this 24.8″ polypropylene sword features a signature inward curve and authentic detailing. Lightweight yet strong, it’s perfect for controlled practice or as a striking prop piece.

settings.title: Spartan Sword PP
settings.text: Modeled after the iconic Spartan weapon, this 29.1″ sword offers impressive durability and balance. Its realistic design and solid build make it a reliable training tool for martial artists and enthusiasts alike.
Develop timing, control, and reflexes with our durable nunchaku collection — available in foam, wood, and metal chain options for all skill levels.

settings.title: TPR Knife
settings.text: Durable and flexible thermoplastic rubber knife designed for realistic martial arts and self-defense training. Safe for repeated use, with an ergonomic grip for comfort and control during practice or stage use.

settings.title: Training Guns
settings.text: Realistic rubber and TPR replicas built for safe, supervised self-defense and firearms handling drills. These lifelike training pistols provide authentic weight and detailing — perfect for instructor-led sessions or film props.

settings.title: Mace PP
settings.text: High-quality polypropylene mace replica crafted for safe demonstrations, props, or cosplay. Lightweight yet durable, it replicates the look of traditional maces for authentic, non-contact training and display.

settings.title: WARNING: DO NOT DISPLAY IN PUBLIC.

settings.text: Honor the roots of martial arts with iconic traditional weapons — from Tonfa and Sai to Batons, made for both practice and display.

settings.title: Tonfa
settings.text: Traditional Okinawan training weapon made from hardwood, foam, or durable PP for versatile practice. Perfect for solo drills, blocking, and striking in self-defense or martial arts training.

settings.title: Chrome Sai
settings.text: Classic pronged baton weapon used in Okinawan and Japanese martial arts. Built for demonstration and kata practice under instructor guidance. Offer authentic design across multiple size options.

settings.title: Expandable Baton
settings.text: Steel training baton with foam handle and locking mechanism for realistic defensive practice. Expands with a flicking motion and includes a belt holder—ideal for instructor-led or tactical training sessions.
Essential equipment for martial arts and boxing — durable, reliable, and built to improve your training performance.

settings.title: Dbl Dynamite Kick Pad
settings.text: Triple-layer foam kick pad with reinforced handle and signature “clap” sound. Built for durability and performance, it keeps martial arts, Taekwondo, and kickboxing training safe and effective.

settings.title: Starburst Double Kick Paddle
settings.text: Youth-friendly kick paddle with cushioned target and shock-absorbing core. Ergonomic grip and vibrant colors make striking practice safe, fun, and effective for beginners and young athletes.

settings.title: Diamond Double Clapper
settings.text: Durable kick paddle with high-density foam and vinyl shell. Ergonomic handle and clapping sound provide instant feedback, making martial arts and kick training engaging and motivating.
Train harder, strike faster, and build power with our durable punch bags and stands. Ideal for boxing, martial arts, and home or gym workouts to sharpen your technique and reflexes.

settings.title: Drako Speed Bag
settings.text: Durable leather bag or striking skull graphic. Combines excellent rebound with visual appeal to enhance training sessions.

settings.title: Drako M-Advanced Speed Bag
settings.text: Leather speed bag with internal bladder for strength, stamina, and speed training. Suitable for all skill levels and training setups.

settings.title: Drako Rapidfire Speed Bag
settings.text: Tear-drop shaped speed bag made with synthetic leather for durability and consistent rebound. Ideal for improving speed, timing, and reflexes at home or in the gym.

settings.title: Swivel
settings.text: Ensure smooth, 360° speed bag rotation with durable swivels built for home or gym training. Available in stainless steel or chrome-plated brass for reliable performance.

settings.title: Double End Ball
settings.text: Improve speed, reflexes, and accuracy with responsive double end balls. Available in engineered or full leather, perfect for boxing and martial arts drills.
